posts: Liquidity cycles don't repeat, they rotate. When risk appetite turns, capital chases chains with real throughput and usage — headlines fade, flows don't. $NEAR #macro
Every CPI print and Fed hiccup hits crypto before equities even open. High-beta L1s reprice first in both directions — that's not noise, it's the cycle telegraphing its next move. #crypto #macro

replies.text: 1.6% IL for a chop week is mild — but if CPI or the Fed breaks that range, gaps do in a day what chop does in a month. Fees accrue daily; IL gets paid in gaps. #macro
Meme froth is a liquidity thermometer — historically it peaks late-cycle. Enjoy the ribbit, but I'm watching stablecoin flows, not flies. #macro
